title: HEXAGES BANKNOTES
description: HexagesBanknotes is a physical money plugin for Minecraft servers that allows players to convert virtual currency into banknotes and redeem them later.
body:
# 💸 HexagesBanknotes

HexagesBanknotes adds a fully customizable physical money system to Minecraft servers.

Players can convert their economy balance into banknote items and redeem them later by simply right-clicking the banknote. The plugin is lightweight, optimized, and designed to provide a realistic economy experience for your server.

The plugin includes a powerful in-game GUI editor that allows administrators to create, edit, and delete banknotes without restarting the server. All changes are automatically saved to the configuration files instantly.

HexagesBanknotes integrates seamlessly with Vault-based economy plugins and supports PlaceholderAPI placeholders for displaying player balances in scoreboards, TAB lists, holograms, and more.

## ✨ Features

* 💰 Physical banknote items
* 🖥️ Advanced in-game banknote editor
* ✏️ Create, edit, and delete banknotes
* 🖱️ Right-click banknote redemption
* 📊 Real-time player balance viewer
* 🔊 Sound and title feedback effects
* 📦 Automatic configuration saving
* 🔗 Vault & EssentialsX compatibility
* 📈 PlaceholderAPI support
* ⚡ Lightweight and optimized performance
* 🧩 Paper & Spigot support

![banknotes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/596bab833219b9d5b09bca1e3b9cf59d00886060.png)

## 🖥️ Commands

### General Commands

* `/banknotes` — Opens the help menu
* `/banknotes editor` — Opens the banknote editor GUI
* `/banknotes list` — Lists all available banknotes
* `/banknotes reload` — Reloads plugin configuration files

### Banknote Management

* `/banknotes create <id> <amount> [name]` — Creates a new banknote
* `/banknotes give <id> [player] [amount]` — Gives banknotes to a player

## 📦 Dependencies

### Required

* Vault
* EssentialsX

### Optional

* PlaceholderAPI
